meta_title: AdSpot - Free ads on Telegram for your channel, bot or website
meta_desc: Promote your Telegram channel, group, bot, mini app or website for free. 1 free ad every day on @adspotchannel and partner channels, translated and improved by AI.
sub: Post a free ad every day for your channel, group, bot, mini app or website. Write it in your language, our AI does the rest.
stat3: every ad checked by a human
mock_text: Your ad, your image and a button to your link, seen by real people.
f_title: Everything you need to get noticed
f1d: Your title, your text, an optional image and a button to your link. No hidden fees.
f2d: Write in any language: the AI translates your ad, improves it and suggests hashtags.
f3d: Create your ad in the mini app and see exactly how it will look before you send it.
f4d: No scams, no spam. Every ad is reviewed before it goes live, so people trust what they see.
f5d: Pick a partner channel and your ad is also shown to its subscribers.
f6d: Business, crypto, games, tech, education and more: your ad reaches the right people.
s1d: Start @PostOnAdSpotBot and tap Post my ad. Everything happens inside Telegram.
s2d: Title, text, image, link and category. Let the AI polish it in one tap.
s3d: After a quick check, your ad is posted on @adspotchannel and on your partner channel.
extra_d: Post a second ad the same day for 50 Telegram Stars. Your first ad of the day is always free.
pt_title: Got a channel? Get free subscribers
pt_sub: Add AdSpot to your channel in 1 click. Your channel shows 1 to 3 ads a day, and every advertiser who picks it must join it.
pt_b1: New subscribers every day, for free
pt_b2: 1 to 3 ads a day, spaced out automatically
pt_b4: Change the settings or stop anytime
a1: Yes. You can post 1 free ad every day. Only a second ad on the same day costs 50 Telegram Stars.
q2: Which languages can I write in?
a2: Any language. The AI translates your ad so that people all over the world can understand it.
a3: Ads that break the rules (scams, adult content, fake giveaways) or that are too low quality are refused. You get a message and can try again.
q4: Do I need to join a channel?
a4: Yes, you need to join @adspotchannel, and the partner channel if you choose one. That is how the service stays free.
a5: Most ads are checked and published within a few hours.
final_sub: It takes 2 minutes. It is free. It is inside Telegram.
pp_meta_title: Become an AdSpot partner - Free subscribers for your Telegram channel
pp_meta_desc: Add AdSpot to your Telegram channel in 1 click: show 1 to 3 ads a day and every advertiser who picks your channel must join it.
pp_sub: Become an AdSpot partner: your channel shows a few quality ads, and advertisers must subscribe to it to post. More subscribers, zero work.
pp_s1d: Tap the button: Telegram opens, choose your channel and confirm. The rights are already set.
pp_s2d: Choose your topics, your language and 1 to 3 ads a day. Done.
pp_s3d: Advertisers who choose your channel must join it before their ad is sent.
pp_r1: Only ads checked by a human, matching your topics
pp_r2: Posts spaced out during the day, never a flood
pp_r3: Every ad is deleted after 24 hours
pp_r4: Remove the bot anytime, everything stops at once
pp_a1: Any public Telegram channel. Small channels are welcome too: it is the best way to start growing.
pp_q2: Which rights does the bot need?
pp_a2: Only post, edit and delete messages, so it can publish the ads and remove them after 24 hours.
pp_a3: You earn subscribers: every advertiser who picks your channel has to join it.
